ticks.note: ABRO with immediate triggers. `A` and `B` are present in tick 1, so both regions finish in the entry tick. Inside the reset loop `if R abort to ABO` KIELER's netlist code loses this entry-tick join (see `26-join-lost-in-entry-tick-under-abort`): `O` is absent. The priority-based compiler rejects the chart.
`A`, `B` and `R`: the strong abort does not fire any more: once every region of `WaitAB` is final without the join having fired, nothing in `ABO` can react.
`A` and `B`: nothing. The chart is stuck for ever.
